Build and the repository test pass.

## Summary

Set up a Maven Spring Boot project at `nohook/rep1` (Spring Boot 3.4.1, Java 21):

- **`pom.xml`** — `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa`, `spring-boot-starter-web`, `postgresql` (runtime), `h2` + `spring-boot-starter-test` (test scope).
- **`DemoApplication`** — entry point.
- **`model/Item`** — sample JPA entity.
- **`repository/ItemRepository`** — `JpaRepository<Item, Long>`.
- **`controller/ItemController`** — REST endpoints (`GET`/`POST /items`) wired to the repository.
- **`src/main/resources/application.properties`** — points at a local PostgreSQL (`jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/demo`), `ddl-auto=update`.
- **`src/test/resources/application.properties`** — overrides to H2 in-memory for tests.
- **`ItemRepositoryTest`** — `@DataJpaTest` verifying save/find round-trip.

Verified with `mvn test` — build succeeds, the repository test passes against H2. To run against a real database, start a PostgreSQL instance matching the credentials in `application.properties` (or adjust them) and `mvn spring-boot:run`.

## Summary

Set up a Maven Spring Boot project at `nohook/rep1` (Spring Boot 3.4.1, Java 21):

- **`pom.xml`** — `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa`, `spring-boot-starter-web`, `postgresql` (runtime), `h2` + `spring-boot-starter-test` (test scope).
- **`DemoApplication`** — entry point.
- **`model/Item`** — sample JPA entity.
- **`repository/ItemRepository`** — `JpaRepository<Item, Long>`.
- **`controller/ItemController`** — REST endpoints (`GET`/`POST /items`) wired to the repository.
- **`src/main/resources/application.properties`** — points at a local PostgreSQL (`jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/demo`), `ddl-auto=update`.
- **`src/test/resources/application.properties`** — overrides to H2 in-memory for tests.
- **`ItemRepositoryTest`** — `@DataJpaTest` verifying save/find round-trip.
